subject.title: Gateway runtime: "no such table: plugin_state_entries / acp_sessions" despite tables existing in state/openclaw.sqlite (agent turns produce no reply)

question: Should maintainers treat the merged container-startup migration fix as covering this missing-table issue, or require a fresh current-main Docker repro with resolved DB-path diagnostics for startup, plugin-state, and ACP?
rationale: The closest merged fix changed adjacent container startup convergence, but this report claims the target tables already exist in the expected database, so accepting that fix without path proof could close a distinct runtime mismatch.

options.title: Require Current-Main Path Proof
options.body: Keep this open until a Docker run on current main logs or exports the startup, plugin-state, and ACP SQLite paths and confirms whether the missing-table failure still occurs.

options.title: Close Under Container-Migration Fix
options.body: Close only if maintainers confirm this report is another symptom of the container startup migration gap fixed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101881.

recommendation.title: Require Current-Main Path Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this open until a Docker run on current main logs or exports the startup, plugin-state, and ACP SQLite paths and confirms whether the missing-table failure still occurs.
